regions.name: Wake Cove
regions.theme: Tutorial shelter — cliff stacks, calm shallows, first trust between rider and Galevein
regions.narrative: A Galevein rests in the lee of the home stacks. Three low rings teach weight and beat before the open sea takes you seriously.
regions.ambientLine: She answers you in the cove. Out past the stacks, the keepers are lighting their lamps.

regions.name: Keeper Shallows
regions.theme: Inner archipelago — patrol lights, modular ruins, echo-friendly rain
regions.narrative: Home waters under keeper watch. Beacons thread between tide viaducts and the storm spire — rebuild confidence before the canyon tightens.
regions.ambientLine: Echo through the rain. The first lights are still slow — use that.

regions.name: Serpent Reach
regions.theme: Weaving canyon slot and cinder coast — dive gates, drowned hearths, harbor works
regions.narrative: The canyon throat rewards threading at speed. Beyond it, char on the water — four burned longhouses and one spared torch. Collect altitude over the harbor works.
regions.ambientLine: Char on the water. Four hearths — and only one was spared.

regions.name: Rib Wastes
regions.theme: Bleached bone arches and keeper works — vast ribs, gale spire, long night
regions.narrative: Ribs like sea-stacks. Whatever hunted the keepers' fathers was real. The gale spire marks the last shelter before the open night.
regions.ambientLine: Ribs like sea-stacks. The keepers turn faster now — break their lock or fall.

regions.name: Aurora Gate
regions.theme: Tempest sea-stack ring — aurora curtain, final beacon, nightfall escape
regions.narrative: The stacks close ranks behind you. The aurora pours into the gate like a tide. One beacon remains — reach it before nightfall swallows the road.
regions.ambientLine: The aurora pours in like a tide. Home — or whatever waits on the other side.
